eyebrow: ago(): filtering by a time window
caption: ago(24h) means 24 hours before now — almost every real hunting query starts by narrowing to a window like this.

code:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| join kind=inner (
    ThreatIntelligenceIndicator
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
) on $left.IPAddress == $right.NetworkIP
caption: kind=inner keeps only sign-ins whose IP address also appears in the threat intelligence feed — a real correlation pattern.

code:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| join kind=inner (
    ThreatIntelligenceIndicator
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
) on $left.IPAddress == $right.NetworkIP
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, ThreatType, Description
caption: The joined row carries columns from both tables — a sign-in paired with exactly why that IP is considered malicious.
